newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index eases in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index eases in quiet trading.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, eased by 0.13 points to 327.43 in a quiet Monday trading session, brokers said.
Total volume was lower at 4.21 million rupees on 213,205 shares from 19.70 million rupees on 769,694 shares last Friday.
Brokers said the slightly lower Semdex still reflected the falling share price of national airline company Air Mauritius.

Air Mauritius lost 2.0 rupees to 50 on 9,870 shares. Last Friday, Air Mauritius also fell by 2.0 rupees just after chairman and managing director Sir Harry Tirvengadum announced he would leave the airline for multinational carrier Air Afrique in 1997.
"Owing to the high weighting of Air Mauritius in the Semdex, such a loss in its share price was sufficient to drag the index down," one broker said.

Bourse officials said stocks in the rest of the market traded in tight ranges as investors retreated to the sidelines ahead of a government cabinet reshuffle which Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam indicated would be completed before parliament reconvenes on November 26.
"The identity of the new finance minister is the main concern for all of us and since this will be known soon, some players prefer to adopt a shy mood now," the broker added.

Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 1,411 shares while State Bank of Mauritius rose 20 cents to 8.70 rupees on 96,300 shares. State Bank eased by 20 cents last Friday on ex-dividend trading.
Building blocks manufacturer United Basalt Products gained 10 cents to 28.20 rupees on 600 shares while Mauritius Development Investment Trust was 10 cents higher to 7.30 rupees on 200 shares.
Rogers was unchanged at 90.50 rupees on 10,200 shares but Ireland Blyth lost 10 cents to 13.50 rupees on 1,875 shares.
Hotel stock New Mauritius Hotel was stable at 29.50 rupees on 44,500 shares.
